programme.desc: The Japanese garden comes from the ancient Japanese tradition. It can be found in private homes as well as in city parks and historical sites: Buddhist temples, Shinto tombs, castles. In Japan, garden design is an important and respected art, sharing aesthetic codes with calligraphy and wash painting. The Japanese garden seeks to interpret and idealize nature by limiting artifice.

But she is also queen in one of the disciplines practiced by creators around the world: design. Welcome to Stockholm, the capital of Nordic design, soothed, calm, nature and zen. Here, the design is erected in religion, and the designers, gurus of the kind, are counted by hundreds. Welcome in the heart of the creative bubbling of the Swedish capital, to meet those who make the Scandinavian design.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Cubism" at the Centre Pompidou. This exhibition gathers more than 300 works and focuses on the history of this founding movement of the 20th century. We will start from the sources of cubism, by presenting what the artists saw and looked at to free themselves from all the academic conventions of this time. We will also see that music had a very important place in the works of this movement as in the work "Musical Instruments" by Georges Braque.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Sunflowers are among Van Gogh's most famous paintings. The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam has dedicated an exhibition to these works and Exhibition on screen, which was given exclusive access to the event, guides us through the exhibition to investigate the mysteries surrounding these paintings. The film also takes us to Tokyo, Philadelphia, London and Munich to follow the 5 main works in the exhibition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considered the founder of modern art, is Spain's most acclaimed artist. As well as a gifted observer of Spanish life and its turbulent past, he is a gifted portraitist and social commentator. With Goya, the art of portraiture reached new heights. This major exhibition at London's National Gallery brings his genius back into the spotlight. Through a formidable collection of unique works and letters by Goya, we analyze the man himself and the world he painted.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. 

There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. 

David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
TV chefs Aldo Zilli and Ching He-Huang do battle on this Road Trip around South Eastern England, aided by experts Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw. 

Aldo plumps for a gold ring despite expert advice while Ching hopes antiques with an eastern origin will far well at auction in north London.

Aldo stops off to meet a 200 year old named ‘Jill’ to hear how she supplied locals with flour. And animal lover Ching learns how one man faced ridicule and ruin while trying to protect cattle in the 19th century.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: What is the Arab world? It is not easy to define this expression as it brings together territories as immense as they are diverse, cultures which share common traits but which each have their specificities. The Museum of the Institute of the Arab World endeavors to offer a vision of this world as rich as it is diverse, through numerous archaeological pieces, treasures of history and culture. But also, thanks to contemporary works, which help to tell what the Arab world is today, in a world shaken by cultural globalization and the questioning of the identities inherent in our modern society.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Today, Travelers takes you to Zurich, Switzerland. We'll start our tour on Banhoffstrasse, one of the most expensive avenues in the world, where many luxury brands have set up shop. We will show you the best photo spots in the city, and we will visit the Grossmünster cathedral. We'll go to the Kunsthaus museum which traces the history of art from the 13th century to the present day. We will make you love Zurich!

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures makes you discover the Thiers Library in Paris. It is a place that houses many treasures that we do not suspect the existence. Today, we will visit this exceptional place which is the property of the Institute of France in search of the treasures it contains. Experts, historians, librarians, will guide us through the corridors and floors of this magical place.

programme.title: Paris under Japanese influence
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Japanese architects think about reinventing Paris drawing Metabolism, which converts Japanese megalopolis like Tokyo. They stood out in 1971 for the support of the construction of the Center Pompidou; the opportunity to display their new vision of urban planning. Japanese architects then participate in numerous competitions for major works in Paris but will never be successful. Not until the late 1980s for their first major achievements finally emerging in the capital.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures takes you on a journey to discover the unsuspected secrets and treasures of the National Assembly in France. Some of the most delicate works are kept in the greatest secrecy. But this place, which is the temple of the French democracy, opens its doors to us exceptionally today. We will make you discover this emblematic universe, more known for its political episodes than for the treasures that it shelters.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Exhibition on Screen takes us through the streets of Paris and then to the heart of a superb exhibition at Cambridge's Fitzwilliam Museum, whose impressive collection of Degas works is the most representative in Britain. Having benefited from exclusive access to a wide variety of rare works, the film tells the story of Degas' quest for perfection through experimentation.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tiziano Vecellio, called Titian, is an undisputed master of the 16th century! His fame spread rapidly from his native town of Venice, to spread throughout Italy and Europe. Popes, kings and emperors all commissioned his portraits. Technical innovations, social recognition and extremely famous paintings, such as Pastoral Concert or the Venus of Urbino, mark the life of Titian. A life which is impressive both in its richness and in longevity! Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: André Godin, inspired by Charles Fourier's phalanstères, envisioned a palatial communal living space for his workers. From 1860 to 1968, the Guise Familistère, a community built for 1800 inhabitants by the great Fourierist industrialist Jean-Baptiste-André Godin (1817-1889), served as the stage for a social experiment that remained unique in its audacity, scale, and duration. The invention of a "unitary" architecture and urban planning is one of the original and pioneering aspects of the Familistère adventure. This "Social Palace" constituted a true utopia in action, which today once again arouses the interest of historians, sociologists, economists, urban planners, and architects.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Suzanne Valadon was born in 1865. Her son, Maurice Utrillo, was born in 1883. Both were painters, and lived part of their lives in the Montmartre district of Paris. It was a flourishing period for the village. It was in this atmosphere that they enjoyed their hours of glory and drama.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet the artist Hervé Di Rosa. A founding member of the Figuration Libre movement in the 1980s, Hervé Di Rosa has constantly sought to renew his artistic approach, from the use of recurring characters in his paintings to the appropriation of artisanal practices from the ends of the earth. It is in his Parisian studio that he is preparing a new exhibition at the Maison Rouge.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Today we turn up the spice with gourmet gastronomes Tony Singh and Cyrus Todiwala. The chefs are joined by David Harper and Natasha Raskin.

Setting off from Dundee they snake down the east coast of Scotland to the village of Rosewell in Midlothian for an auction. Cyrus proves to have a flair for negotiating and Tony’s not shy at naming his price. 

Tony discovers why one Scottish city was home to many millionaires and Cyrus finds his sea legs as he learns why Anstruther was a pivotal fishing port in the 19th century.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Today, Photo contest takes you to the Rodin Museum. The director of the photographers’ collective Lengos photo prod presents us two of its members who will compete to take the best photograph on the imposed theme: Rodin and his museum.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to the center of Berlin. This is where the artist Maria Volokhova has set up her studio. An artist who navigates the border between art and design, Maria Volokhova is fascinated by the interior of the human or animal body. She creates functional porcelain objects for everyday life, but she is dedicated above all to the aesthetics of her art.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Pierre Bonnard. You will discover his labour with Woman dozing on a bed, Summer in Normandy or The beach in low tide.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: David Hockney, generally considered one of Britain's most popular artists, has enjoyed worldwide success throughout his life, with exhibitions in London, New York, Paris and elsewhere attracting millions of visitors. This film reveals intimate, previously unseen interviews and focuses on two successful exhibitions that took place in 2012 and 2016 at the Royal Academy of Arts in London.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Eugène Delacroix is considered as the leader of French Romanticism, a simultaneously passionate, dramatic and tormented artistic movement, which emerged at the beginning of the 19th century. However, more than a movement, it is a whole creative and captivating artistic development, which is on offer here, through the study of 10 of the artist’s major works. He was to have a notable influence on all modern artistic movements, which after him, were to explore the power of colour and light. Discover " Liberty leading the people " or " The death of Sardanapalus " exposed at the Louvre.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Named Euphrosyne, Thalia and Aglaia, they embody mirth, abundance and splendour. They are the Three Graces, daughters of Jupiter and companions of Venus. A very prized subject as early as the Renaissance, it allowed for a triple representation of the female nude in all its ideal beauty. Observe their grace in the painting by Raphael and the delicacy of their veils in Botticelli’s “La Primavera” or in a magnificent work by Cranach recently acquired by the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 episodes, fun and educational, you will know how to draw an airplane, a fireman, a haunted mansion, a soccer player, a sunset, a lion, the Eiffel Tower, seashells, a fairy... Our master draftsman Gia-Haï Phan will show you the basics of a successful drawing: proportions, perspectives, values, contrasts, volumes, blending, everything is covered.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: What to do with our dead? Burn them? Bury them? Make them disappear? Keep them within easy reach?\r\nWe're 70km from Barcelona, behind Montserrat. Here, as all over Spain, we don't bury the dead, we pile them up in niches and superimposed vaults. The new Igualada cemetery, for example, will be the work of two Catalan architects at the very start of their careers, Enric Miralles and Carme Pinos. The project is surprising because it blends into the landscape. The land is hollowed out, inhabited by strange alignments of oblique concrete walls, covered with earth and planted. Is it a building? Or rather a place? A place enriched by the very fact that it's not finished? A strong link between twentieth-century architecture and landscape, between Le Corbusier and Richard Long.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen

The Barnes Collection in Philadelphia has more paintings by Renoir than any other gallery in the world, and it's here that we'll attempt to lift the veil on the remarkable story of this incredible artist.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc:
The Centre Administratif de Pantin, a gigantic vessel of raw concrete, washed up on the banks of the Ourcq Canal in the early 1970s, in a Paris suburb known as the “Red Belt”.
Its architect, Jacques Kalisz, had not yet built anything. Sensitive to Marxist theories, he had no formal qualifications at the time. The mayor of Pantin commissioned him to design an unprecedented facility, the Cité Administrative, which was to bring together a range of administrative, social and legal services (court, social security, police station, tax office, trade union center, ANPE, morgue, kennels, etc.), all in a single location. 
20 years later, the center is deserted. It was the failure of a social utopia. The “People's Palace” is nothing but an empty shell. Destroying it would have been too expensive. So it was decided to renovate it.
In 2004, the building underwent a radical change of use: offices and employees gave way to dance companies and rehearsal studios. A new cultural center, the Centre Nat.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Roissy 1 embodied the aspirations of modern architecture. It was the early days of mass travel, a pre-crisis era that believed in progress and dreamed of speed. It was also the beginning of architecture's role in the construction of airport terminals. With Roissy 1, it was no longer airplanes but architecture that would be admired. He was 29 years old at the time, and it was his 1st building - the very beginning of a long series of some fifty platforms worldwide that would make him one of the greatest terminal architects of the 20th century.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures

A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc:
Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.

It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.

Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.

The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.desc: Passionate about horticulture, Monet remains the undisputed master of garden painting in the history of art, but he was not alone. Artists such as Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso and Matisse used the garden as a strong theme in their work. These great artists, along with many other famous names, are brought together in an innovative exhibition from the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Royal Gallery of Arts in London. From the exhibition itself to the beauty of artists' gardens such as Monet's at Giverny, we take a journey to discover how the modern garden was used to explore radical and wondrous new ideas.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen

Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?\r\nThis new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: "I envy the Japanese", wrote Van Gogh to his brother Theo. Thanks to the exhibition on which this film is based, at the Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam, we understand why. Although Vincent van Gogh never visited Japan, it remains the country that had the greatest influence on him and his work. By visiting Japanese art galleries in Paris and creating his own image of Japan after extensive research, print collections and lengthy discussions with other artists, the discovery of Japanese art took van Gogh's career in an exciting new direction.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc:
The Villa Dall’Ava, designed by Rem Koolhaas in 1991, is an iconic project located on the heights of Saint-Cloud, near Paris. This house is distinguished by its bold architecture and geometric forms that challenge the traditional conventions of a typical villa. The structure consists of shifted volumes, with two apartment boxes appearing to float above the pool, creating an impression of lightness.

Koolhaas faced significant technical and aesthetic challenges during the design of the villa. On one hand, he dealt with opposition from neighbors concerned about the visual and structural impact of the house on the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, he had to devise ingenious solutions to support the weight of the boxes and the pool, which holds 65 tons of water. The villa incorporates carefully planned internal supports and a drainage system to ensure the stability of the structure.

In addition to these challenges, Villa Dall’Ava serves as a reflection on modern living and the rel.

programme.desc: In this episode, Luana welcomes Héloïse Brion, creator of "Miss Maggie's Kitchen," for a unique culinary journey in Normandy. Héloïse, who has French-American roots, offers a clever blend of her American heritage and her life in Normandy. Together, they cook two original recipes: a stuffed squash with apples, inspired by local traditions, and a pecan pie, emblematic of American cuisine.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo offers a recipe for celeriac risotto with citrus powder. She will also prepare black rice with spring vegetables. A real treat for the taste buds!

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: He takes us to Petra in Jordan. We discover how the Nabataeans became specialists in collecting rainwater, which they managed meticulously. Then, we find ourselves in Las Vegas, on the verge of a shortage, and in Amman, Jordan, to discover the daily difficulties linked to the shortage and rationing of water. In Israel, the Dead Sea is disappearing. Due to intensive agriculture, the Jordan River and other rivers no longer supply it with enough water. In France, the Loire is for nature lovers, today a multitude of species have come to recolonise the river, including the famous wild salmon. In Jordan, in the red desert of Wadi Rum, we meet Khaleel Maiteq, who shares with us his life and that of his animals in a desert environment where water is a very rare commodity.

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your ow.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

This newfound passion thoroughly changed her lifestyle, ultimately resulting in a move to Bali, Indonesia. Today, she runs mindful surf & yoga retreats while also working online as a wellness writer.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy, and is also recognized as Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Discover an Italian culinary staple: ravioli. Luana Belmondo, accompanied by her son Alessandro, makes her recipe for ricotta arugula ravioli with artichoke and almond sauce. The duo also prepare choco ravioli stuffed with pistachio custard and strawberry coulis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: We find ourselves in Israel in the Negev desert, Elaine is looking for solutions to combat desertification. The object of her research: trees, which consume little water. In Mali, we meet the Dogon: the desert farmers. He shows us his people's recipes for managing water. In this part of Mali, where it almost never rains. In Palestine, the village of Wadi Fukeen. A village where farmers use an irrigation and water-sharing system that is over 300 years old and based on respect and trust. And in Gaza, Palestine, where specialists are fighting to save Palestinian children made ill by unsafe water. In the Jordan Valley, where three countries in conflict face the same problems: the lack of water. In Brazil's water tower, where the exceptionally pure water is threatened by iron ore mining that pollutes the water table. And in Jerusalem, Israel, where sustainable development is only possible if people manage to make peace with each other, to live together.

programme.title: Earth from above
programme.desc: Water and its beauty, water and its power, water and its fragility... the water we all need is becoming scarce, through our own fault. Some rivers are dry, others are diverted, cut off by dams, others are simply polluted, and this for decades. We will discover how humans transformed the nature in Argentina, then in China and its disproportionate Three Gorges Dam. We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. Vu du Ciel makes you discover once again another world, magnificent but threatened.

programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

Le Guilvinec may be the first French artisanal fishing port, but all the seashores of France have good seasonal products. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

In Corsica, in the Bouches de Bonifacio, the Mediterranean basin is one of the richest in biodiversity on the planet. In Corsica, with overfishing. In Guinea-Bissau, the Bijagos, a string of a hundred or so islands, fish abound in these waters, but for how much longer? In Corsica, on the Sanguinaires Islands, almost 50% of the fish we eat comes from farming. In Norway, the sea is very fragile. There is a balance that has been established over millions of.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: We travel to an island resort in Fiji known for it’s daring shark encounters! To hear and see first hand the amazing conservation work they’re doing. Along the way we meet the local school kids and learn about how they’re helping protect the reef.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: We travel to an idyllic island in the South Pacific, known for its enviable coral reef and chance to swim with giant Manta Rays! We also visit the local village to learn about its important relationship with the resort and hear how tourism has helped.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: In this action packed episode, we travel to Australia’s favorite Playground - the Gold Coast, to prove family vacations can have it all! Fun and education; beach and the rainforest; roller coasters and wildlife. It’s a destination that’s as beautiful as it is FUN!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive. On the way, we will stop at the Sourdon family's house to cook sea bream accompanied by an olive fricot. We will then go to Aix en Provence to prepare a strange dessert: the Fernand-style oil pump. Then we head for an exceptional estate, the Villa Beaulieu, to taste a Bagna Cauda like you have rarely seen before finishing with Jean-Luc Rabanel, a starred organic chef and defenders of grand cru olive oil...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France. Julie will cook a fricassee of berniques, the little Chinese hats that cover the rocks of the coast, as well as pink clams that are little known to the public. We will continue our journey in Finistère to meet Sylvain, the only abalone breeder in the country, and then to Méru where there are still workshops magnifying this sublime material. The Chef Jean-Marie Baudic will cook scallops like no one else.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Every year, the return of summer is a special moment, heralding the arrival of all those beautiful fruits on the shelves. Whether red, exotic or forgotten, fruit is an essential part of our diet. Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll head to Céret, the cherry capital, and then cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan pancakes.

Dietary Supplements: Helpful or Dangerous?
They’re flooding the shelves of pharmacies, supermarkets, and health food stores. Brewer’s yeast, vitamins, passionflower, spirulina… More than one in two French people have already taken dietary supplements to get back in shape or stay healthy.
A capsule for memory, a tablet for stress, a herbal detox programme… The promises made by dietary supplements are tempting. These products are guaranteed to be 100 per cent natural, which stands in stark contrast to the chemical image associated with medicines. But are they really effective and safe?
The range of dietary supplements on offer is vast, with over 150 million packs sold in France every year. As summer approaches, many female consumers turn to slimming products. A flat tummy, slimmer legs… Their promises sound too good to be true, but are they actually effective for weight loss?

programme.title: Adevăruri tulburătoare
programme.desc: Recuperarea adevărului istoric ar trebui să devină pentru oricare trăitor onest al acestor meleaguri un obiectiv esenţial al existenţei sale. Criza de identitate cu care se confruntă astăzi poporul român este dovada faptului că falsul istoric al descendenţei noastre, întreţinut de atâta vreme, şi-a atins ţinta. În acelaşi timp, setea de adevăr şi instinctul care îi determină pe foarte mulţi să respingă teoria romanizării Daciei este un semn al puterii de regenerare ce caracterizează acest neam. Dacă până acum ne-au separat atâtea, iată că există ceva care ne poate aduna laolaltă: adevărata noastră identitate, adevăratele noastre rădăcini, demnitatea pe care ne-o dă faptul că suntem descendenţii poporului de nemuritori din Valea Dunării. Traco-geto-dacii aşteaptă să li se facă dreptate, iar emisiunea „Adevăruri tulburătoare” e locul în care lucrurile vor ieşi la lumină!

programme.title: Miezul problemei
programme.desc: Emisiunea aduce în prim-plan analiza lucidă si dezbaterea echilibrată a celor mai importante subiecte ale zilei. Fiecare ediţie abordează teme esenţiale din domenii precum politica, economia, societatea, administraţia publică şi evenimentele internaţionale cu impact direct asupra României. În platou sunt invitaţi politicieni, analişti, jurnalişti, economişti, reprezentanţi ai societăţii civile sau experţi relevanţi pentru subiectele discutate. Aceştia contribuie la o dezbatere dinamică, bazată pe argumente, date şi opinii bine fundamentate. "Miezul problemei" nu este doar o emisiune de actualitate, ci un spaţiu de dialog autentic, unde întrebările importante primesc răspunsuri directe, iar telespectatorii sunt invitaţi să înţeleagă dincolo de aparenţe.

programme.title: Doza de frumusețe și stil
programme.desc: O emisiune despre eleganță, stil, sănătate și îngrijire, componentele frumuseții! Octaviana Alexe vă va introduce în lumea glamour și va avea alături, în fiecare sâmbătă, specialiști în estetică, hair-style, make-up, nutriție sau stomatologie, care ne vor prezenta cele mai moderne proceduri, de la clasicele tratamente cosmetice până la cele mai complexe intervenții estetice, modalități de îngrijire sau trucuri de înfrumusețare la îndemnâna oricui. Vom învăța de la stiliști și designeri celebri cum să transformăm o ținută banală într-una spectaculoasă, despre cum ne accesorizăm ținutele în funcție de eveniment sau cum ne creăm un stil vestimentar care să ne definească.

programme.title: Actul 2
programme.desc: Viața este ca o scenă deschisă, cu actori de top, care ne-au marcat. Ana Donosa, actriță la Teatrul de Revistă "Constantin Tănase" este gazda unei noi emisiuni de suflet. Vom râde și vom plânge alături de invitații ei, actori consacrați dar și tineri care fac din această pasiune o meserie. Nae Alexandru, Cristian Simion, Adriana Trandafir sau Petru Păun sunt doar câteva dintre numele pe care le-am admirat pe scena de teatru sau în filme, și care ne dezvăluie momente importante din viața lor. Intrăm în Actul 2, în fiecare sâmbătă, și ieșim mai proaspeți, mai bogați, mai sentimentali, mai nostalgici.

programme.title: Sărut-mâna, mamă
programme.desc: Cea dintâi iubire a oricărui om este propria mamă, iar cea de pe urmă, cea mai durabilă dragoste, este aceea a mamei pentru copilul ei. Între aceste două puncte ale iubirii se derulează emisiunea Sărut mâna, mamă.\nDovezile iubirii de mamă, multe la limita extraordinarului, sunt descoperite de echipa emisiunii aduse în faţa telespectatorilor de Fuego, un prezentator pe cât de surprinzător în ipostaza de om de televiziune, pe atât de cald, de apropiat oamenilor, de sensibil.\nExistă nenumărate motive pentru care putem mulţumi mamei. Există zeci de momente în viaţă în care simţim nevoia să facem acest lucru. Şi mai există, de asemenea, un loc în care puteţi spune tot ceea ce simţiţi faţă de persoana care v-a dăruit viaţă, arătând lumii întregi că dragostea de mamă este mai presus de orice.

programme.title: Dezastre în aer
programme.desc: Serialul Dezastre în aer analizează cauzele care au provocat aceste incidente și dacă ar fi putut fi evitate. Aceste evenimente au contribuit la adoptarea de noi măsuri privind securitatea în transportul aerian, producând unele dintre cele mai importante schimbări în regulamentele aviatice. Mărturiile supraviețuitorilor și reconstituirile înfățișează povești impresionante, iar grafica computerizată și experții în domeniu explică motivele aflate la baza producerii evenimentelor fatale sau aproape fatale.

programme.desc: Serialul Dezastre în aer analizează cauzele care au provocat aceste incidente și dacă ar fi putut fi evitate. programme.title: Aeroport
programme.desc: Aeroportul Ataturk din Istanbul, casa companiei Turkish Airlines de zeci de ani, este pe cale să se închidă. Peste oraș, își va începe operațiunile un nou aeroport ultramodern, dar cu zboruri foarte solicitate și în numai 12 ore trebuie mutat totul în noua locație.

programme.title: Metrou inovator
programme.desc: Documentarul debutează cu un preview dinamic a a ceea ce urmează să ofere seria – și anume povestea din culise a unei echipe de elită care construiește un sistem de metrou revoluționar, complet automatizat, în valoare de 50 de miliarde de dolari. Este, de departe, cea mai mare și mai avansată linie feroviară nouă inaugurată oriunde pe planetă în 2019. O scenă dramatică, în care personajele principale se confruntă cu o criză, dă startul acțiunii. Membrii echipei își exprimă apoi, într-un montaj de opinii, motivele pentru care acest megaproiect este atât de remarcabil și cum va rivaliza cu cele mai bune sisteme din lume. Amploarea uriașă a lucrărilor care urmează este copleșitoare, lucru evidențiat clar într-o prezentare de ansamblu. O secvență CGI spectaculoasă ne arată ce trebuie realizat: tuneluri apar sub Gara Centrală, îndreptându-se spre nord, traversând un adevărat câmp minat de obstacole subterane și stații noi, înainte de a trece pe sub port și de a continua spre nord-vest. Pe traseu apar stații noi, până la un imens depou de întreținere a trenurilor și un centru de comandă, la Rouse Hill, traversând o zonă inundabilă pe un viaduct numit Skytrain. Din Gara Centrală, alte tuneluri se întind spre sud, străbătând orașul până la Bankstown. O altă linie nouă pornește spre Parramatta, cu o conexiune suplimentară către un aeroport nou. Membrii echipei ne spun cât de conștienți sunt de dimensiunea colosală a sarcinii lor și de faptul că au la dispoziție doar câțiva ani pentru a construi totul.

programme.title: Salvatori pe drumuri înghețate
programme.desc: În Odda se porneşte cea mai abundentă ninsoare pe care au văzut-o şoferii de autocamion Thord Paulsen şi Olav Eike, creând haos pe şosele.

programme.title: Dezastre descifrate
programme.desc: Asistați la puterea distructivă și devastatoare dezlănțuită de cea mai valoaroasă resursă a planetei Pământ: apa. Apa acoperă două treimi din suprafața Pământului, iar noi suntem complet dependenți de ea, dar atunci când acest ingredient vital al vieții își descarcă furia asupra planetei, devine mortal. Fie că este vorba de ploaia care inundă solul, râuri care își depășesc malurile sau eforturile noastre eșuate de a controla apa în baraje sau diguri, inundațiile sunt inevitabile și de neoprit. Când milioane de tone de apă intră în contact cu civilizația, rezultatele sunt întotdeauna devastatoare. Orice măsuri de prevenție am lua, oricât de atenți am fi, apa câștigă întotdeauna. Doar 30 cm de apă pot ridica o mașină, iar o undă tsunami de 30 de metri înălțime poate șterge orașe de pe hartă și ucide peste 230.000 de oameni în câteva ore. Inundațiile sunt cel mai comun dezastru natural și, din cauza schimbărilor climatice devin tot mai frecvente.

programme.title: Eșecuri în construcții
programme.desc: Primul episod începe pe un canal olandez aparent obișnuit. Cu toate acestea, ceea ce dezvăluim este ieșit din comun. Este una dintre cele mai mari catastrofe în construcții din istoria recentă: prăbușirea unei macarale telescopice duble, răsturnarea unei barje și prăbușirea unei punți cu o greutate de 187 de tone, toate lovind un cartier rezidențial liniștit și distrugând complet zeci de case. Motivul? O combinație între vânt, lipsă de echilibru și eroarea operatorului de macara. Apoi, călătorim în Asia, unde unele dintre cele mai mari șantiere de construcții se închid înainte să înceapă construcția propriu-zisă. Urmărim colapsul unor șantiere: gropi masive în pământ ce implodează într-un mod dramatic, îngropând ziduri de sprijin, drumuri și echipamente la zeci de metri sub nivelul solului. Condițiile necorespunzătoare ale solului și terenurile asanate par să fie principalele motive ale acestor eșecuri.

programme.title: Lecțiile dezastrului
programme.desc: Simpla trimitere a oamenilor în spațiu este o misiune extrem de riscantă. Aflați într-o rachetă, astronauții trebuie să supraviețuiască exploziei controlate care lansează nava dincolo de atmosferă și forțelor de frecare înspăimântătoare din timpul reintrării. Este un mediu neiertător, în care erori minore au provocat catastrofe mortale și costisitoare. Pentru a-și pregăti pentru viitor noua capsulă pentru spațiul profund, Orion, inginerii NASA trebuie să analizeze în detaliu fiecare dezastru din trecut. De la exploziile devastatoare ale navetelor spațiale până la tragediile Apollo și Soyuz, eșecurile de ieri reprezintă lecții esențiale. Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.

programme.title: Dezastre în aer
programme.desc: Serialul Dezastre în aer analizează cauzele care au provocat aceste incidente și dacă ar fi putut fi evitate. Aceste evenimente au contribuit la adoptarea de noi măsuri privind securitatea în transportul aerian, producând unele dintre cele mai importante schimbări în regulamentele aviatice. Mărturiile supraviețuitorilor și reconstituirile înfățișează povești impresionante, iar grafica computerizată și experții în domeniu explică motivele aflate la baza producerii evenimentelor fatale sau aproape fatale.

programme.title: Ilegal cu Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Premiata jurnalistă Mariana van Zeller explorează structura și funcționarea celor mai periculoase piețe negre din universul interlop. În fiecare episod, jurnalista surprinde o altă piață neagră, de la droguri la arme și comerț cu tigri, cu scopul de a întâlni traficanții, de a afla modul de lucru și a dezvălui circumstanțele și contextul geo-politic care creează o economie subterană de miliarde de dolari.

programme.title: Prognoze îngrijorătoare
programme.desc: Sunt printre cele mai puternice forțe de pe Pământ. Cu vânturi de peste 480 km/h și cu forța de a distruge aproape totul în calea lor, tornadele provoacă, în medie, 60 de decese anual și daune materiale de milioane de dolari. Din Insulele Britanice până în sud-estul Asiei și centrul Statelor Unite, tornadele distrug peisaje și comunități întregi. În acest episod dramatic, vom merge direct în ochiul furtunii alături de vânătorii de tornade și vom vizita cei mai importanți oameni de știință din Europa și Statele Unite care luptă împotriva acestor forțe mortale ale naturii.

programme.title: Climă virală
programme.desc: Tornade în spațiul cosmic, o erupție vulcanică ce produce un boom sonic și o ceață densă ce învăluie Marele Canion și-l face invizibil.

programme.title: Inginerie abandonată
programme.desc: Ruine cunoscute în mijlocul nisipurilor schimbătoare ale deșertului, decoruri legendare cu trecuturi surprinzătoare și locații reale care au inspirat Hollywoodul. În cadrul acestor structuri în descompunere se află ecourile istoriei; fiecare ruină bântuită vine cu propria poveste unică.

programme.title: Marfă de contrabandă
programme.desc: Agenții Marinei din Miami opresc o ambarcațiune suspectată de contrabandă cu droguri. După o căutare intensă, găsesc peste 500 kg de cocaină ascunse în cabină. Între timp, agenții Patrulei de Frontieră a Statelor Unite din Mississippi lansează o operațiune pe o autostradă despre care suspectează că este folosită de carteluri pentru a introduce ilegal droguri, bani și persoane. În largul coastei Floridei, agenții patrulează o rută populară printre contrabandiștii care aduc marfă de contrabandă din Bahamas.

programme.title: Aeroportul din Toronto
programme.desc: La aeroportul din Toronto, temperaturile negative, zăpada și gheața de pe solicită la maxim stația de degivrare. Afară, muncitorii se luptă cu uși de marfă înghețate și conducte sparte, în timp ce în interior izbucnește haosul: un însoțitor de zbor rănit, pasageri furioși și un intrus pătruns într-una dintre cele mai periculoase zone ale aeroportului.

Este, de departe, cea mai mare și mai avansată linie feroviară nouă inaugurată oriunde pe planetă în 2019. O scenă dramatică, în care personajele principale se confruntă cu o criză, dă startul acțiunii. Membrii echipei își exprimă apoi, într-un montaj de opinii, motivele pentru care acest megaproiect este atât de remarcabil și cum va rivaliza cu cele mai bune sisteme din lume. Amploarea uriașă a lucrărilor care urmează este copleșitoare, lucru evidențiat clar într-o prezentare de ansamblu. O secvență CGI spectaculoasă ne arată ce trebuie realizat: tuneluri apar sub Gara Centrală, îndreptându-se spre nord, traversând un adevărat câmp minat de obstacole subterane și stații noi, înainte de a trece pe sub port și de a continua spre nord-vest. Pe traseu apar stații noi, până la un imens depou de întreținere a trenurilor și un centru de comandă, la Rouse Hill, traversând o zonă inundabilă pe un viaduct numit Skytrain. Din Gara Centrală, alte tuneluri se întind spre sud, străbătând orașul până la Bankstown. O altă linie nouă pornește spre Parramatta, cu o conexiune suplimentară către un aeroport nou. Membrii echipei ne spun cât de conștienți sunt de dimensiunea colosală a sarcinii lor și de faptul că au la dispoziție doar câțiva ani pentru a construi totul.

programme.title: Salvatori pe drumuri înghețate
programme.desc: În Odda se porneşte cea mai abundentă ninsoare pe care au văzut-o şoferii de autocamion Thord Paulsen şi Olav Eike, creând haos pe şosele.

programme.title: Lumi ascunse sub orașe
programme.desc: În Midyat, Turcia, arheologii descoperă vastul oraș subteran Matiate, întins pe tuneluri și încăperi săpate acum mii de ani. Dovezile unor biserici, sinagogi și monede romane sugerează că a fost cândva un refugiu pentru cei care fugeau de persecuții religioase. În Royston, Anglia, muncitorii dau peste o cameră misterioasă săpată în cretă, plină de sculpturi religioase complexe. Sub Orvieto, Italia, săpăturile pentru o pivniță de vin scot la iveală Cavità 254, un impresionant complex subteran etrusc. Cândva carieră sau sistem de apă, umplerea sa intenționată cu ceramică și oase sugerează practici ritualice sau simbolice de înmormântare. În final, în Abarkuh, Iran, arheologii cartografiază o vastă rețea de tuneluri subterane, probabil parte a unui vechi sistem de irigații qanat, exemplu al ingeniozității persane, folosit pentru a supraviețui secetei, războiului și căldurii deșertului.

programme.title: Cernobîl
programme.desc: Pe data de 26 aprilie 1986, la ora 1:23 dimineața, o explozie masivă distruge reactorul numărul patru al centralei nucleare de la Cernobîl din Ucraina sovietică. Un test de siguranță a declanșat cel mai grav accident nuclear din istorie, eliberând în atmosferă de 400 de ori mai multe radiații decât bomba de la Hiroshima. În timp ce operatorii din camera de control sunt șocați, pompierii centralei nucleare se luptă cu incendiile, din cauza nivelurilor letale de radiații. La doar 3 km distanță, în orașul Pripyat, oficialii partidului comunist încurajează ca viața să continue normal. Copiii merg la școală, iar cuplurile se căsătoresc în timp ce radiațiile plouă peste ei. Între timp, un nor radioactiv gigantic începe să înconjoare globul. Primul episod urmărește primele 24 de ore ale dezastrului, cu relatări directe ale unor oameni care încearcă cu disperare să înțeleagă un accident despre care nimeni nu credea că s-ar putea întâmpla vreodată.

programme.title: Dinastia Tudorilor
programme.desc: Timp de secole, Maria Stuart, regina Scoției, a fost portretizată ca fiind impulsivă și autodistructivă. Acum, datorită unor noi dovezi și accesului excepțional la informații, Suzannah Lipscomb și Dan Snow dezvăluie fațete mai profunde ale acestei celebre figuri istorice: o regină care s-a confruntat cu violență, adversitate și dușmani vicleni și care a navigat cu abilitate într-un joc politic periculos până la sfârșit.

programme.title: Povestea noastră, cu Morgan Freeman
programme.desc: Morgan călătoreşte prin lume din dorinţa de a înţelege mai profund conceptul de libertate. De la izolarea solitară la lagărele de muncă forţată, la tabuurile sociale şi legile care restricţionează exprimarea opiniilor, Libertatea pare să fie o luptă constantă. Ca indivizi şi ca naţiuni, ne confruntăm cu întrebarea: Vom fi vreodată cu adevărat liberi?

programme.title: Dezastre în aer
programme.desc: Serialul Dezastre în aer analizează cauzele care au provocat aceste incidente și dacă ar fi putut fi evitate. Aceste evenimente au contribuit la adoptarea de noi măsuri privind securitatea în transportul aerian, producând unele dintre cele mai importante schimbări în regulamentele aviatice. Mărturiile supraviețuitorilor și reconstituirile înfățișează povești impresionante, iar grafica computerizată și experții în domeniu explică motivele aflate la baza producerii evenimentelor fatale sau aproape fatale.

programme.title: Ilegal cu Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Premiata jurnalistă Mariana van Zeller explorează structura și funcționarea celor mai periculoase piețe negre din universul interlop. În fiecare episod, jurnalista surprinde o altă piață neagră, de la droguri la arme și comerț cu tigri, cu scopul de a întâlni traficanții, de a afla modul de lucru și a dezvălui circumstanțele și contextul geo-politic care creează o economie subterană de miliarde de dolari.

programme.title: Prognoze îngrijorătoare
programme.desc: Sunt printre cele mai puternice forțe de pe Pământ. Cu vânturi de peste 480 km/h și cu forța de a distruge aproape totul în calea lor, tornadele provoacă, în medie, 60 de decese anual și daune materiale de milioane de dolari. Din Insulele Britanice până în sud-estul Asiei și centrul Statelor Unite, tornadele distrug peisaje și comunități întregi. În acest episod dramatic, vom merge direct în ochiul furtunii alături de vânătorii de tornade și vom vizita cei mai importanți oameni de știință din Europa și Statele Unite care luptă împotriva acestor forțe mortale ale naturii.

programme.title: Climă virală
programme.desc: Tornade în spațiul cosmic, o erupție vulcanică ce produce un boom sonic și o ceață densă ce învăluie Marele Canion și-l face invizibil.

programme.title: Inginerie abandonată
programme.desc: Ruine cunoscute în mijlocul nisipurilor schimbătoare ale deșertului, decoruri legendare cu trecuturi surprinzătoare și locații reale care au inspirat Hollywoodul. În cadrul acestor structuri în descompunere se află ecourile istoriei; fiecare ruină bântuită vine cu propria poveste unică.

programme.title: Supermașini
programme.desc: Pătrundem în uzina Ferrari, de unde provine revoluţionarul model FF, primul model 4x4 al mărcii, cu patru scaune.

programme.title: Inginerie dezastruoasă
programme.desc: Această serie documentară analizează în profunzime dezastrele de mare amploare din inginerie pentru a descoperi erorile umane și defectele de proiectare care au condus la adevărate tragedii. Fiecare episod, bazat pe mărturii ale experților, examinează cauzele științifice ale accidentului și identifică momentele decisive. Ar fi putut fi prevenită tragedia? Prin acest program se caută adevărul, întrebând de ce s-a întâmplat, ce lecții s-au învățat și cum se pot evita greșeli similare în viitor.

programme.title: Africa
programme.desc: După 15 ani de război civil, câmpiile luxuriante din centrul Mozambicului sunt în pericol. Vor reuşi ecologiştii să le redea fosta glorie?

programme.title: Africa
programme.desc: După 15 ani de război civil, câmpiile luxuriante din centrul Mozambicului sunt în pericol. Vor reuşi ecologiştii să le redea fosta glorie?

programme.title: Apollo
programme.desc: Află povestea programului Apollo prin intermediul înregistrărilor NASA rare și materialelor media ale vremii.

programme.title: Lecțiile dezastrului
programme.desc: Simpla trimitere a oamenilor în spațiu este o misiune extrem de riscantă. Aflați într-o rachetă, astronauții trebuie să supraviețuiască exploziei controlate care lansează nava dincolo de atmosferă și forțelor de frecare înspăimântătoare din timpul reintrării. Este un mediu neiertător, în care erori minore au provocat catastrofe mortale și costisitoare. Pentru a-și pregăti pentru viitor noua capsulă pentru spațiul profund, Orion, inginerii NASA trebuie să analizeze în detaliu fiecare dezastru din trecut. De la exploziile devastatoare ale navetelor spațiale până la tragediile Apollo și Soyuz, eșecurile de ieri reprezintă lecții esențiale. Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.

programme.title: Traficanți pe aeroport
programme.desc: Graţie flerului şi talentului de intervievator, poliţiştii descoperă cocaină în două locuri surpriză după ce confruntă doi suspecţi de trafic.

programme.title: Marfă de contrabandă
programme.desc: Agenții Marinei din Miami opresc o ambarcațiune suspectată de contrabandă cu droguri. După o căutare intensă, găsesc peste 500 kg de cocaină ascunse în cabină. Între timp, agenții Patrulei de Frontieră a Statelor Unite din Mississippi lansează o operațiune pe o autostradă despre care suspectează că este folosită de carteluri pentru a introduce ilegal droguri, bani și persoane. În largul coastei Floridei, agenții patrulează o rută populară printre contrabandiștii care aduc marfă de contrabandă din Bahamas.

programme.title: Accident aviatic
programme.desc: În anii 2018 și 2019, două aeronave Boeing 737 MAX s-au prăbușit la doar cinci luni distanță. Foștii anchetatori explică cauzele acestor accidente.

programme.title: Avioane care au schimbat istoria
programme.desc: Descoperă ingineria și tacticile aeriene incredibile folosite de legendarul Supermarine Spitfire. În 1940, în timpul Bătăliei Angliei, acest avion emblematic s-a aflat între Germania nazistă și o invazie amfibie a sudului Angliei. Duelurile aeriene mortale care au avut loc între Spitfire și rivalul său, Messerschmitt Bf 109, aveau să determine soarta bătăliei și să schimbe cursul istoriei.

programme.title: Cursă contracronometru în Chile
programme.desc: După prăbușirea catastrofală a unei mine din Deșertul Atacama, prinși într-o groapă sufocantă și întunecată, la aproape un kilometru sub pământ, 33 de mineri încep lupta pentru supraviețuire. Sub ochii lumii, într-o cursă contracronometru, se desfășoară o operațiune internațională de salvare, una care a intrat în istorie ca un exemplu de ingeniozitate tehnică, de rezistență și de speranță.

programme.title: Tsunami
programme.desc: Un tsunami se soldează cu mii de victime omeneşti, dar cu surprinzător de puţine victime în rândul faunei locale. Oare animalele sălbatice ştiu ceva ce noi nu ştim ?

programme.title: Uraganul Katrina
programme.desc: Uraganul Katrina a fost un dezastru natural, însă tragedia fără precedent ce a urmat a fost creată de om, scoțând la suprafață diviziunile profunde, structurale și rasiale ale Americii. Ceea ce părea inițial o catastrofă pentru toți, indiferent de rasă sau religie, s-a dovedit a fi, în realitate, exact contrariul. În cele două săptămâni de după impactul uraganului Katrina, milioane de vieți, în principal ale persoanelor de culoare de pe Coasta Golfului, au fost distruse sau pierdute, iar Katrina a confirmat ceea ce fiecare persoană de culoare știa deja: America nu are grijă de oamenii de culoare.

programme.title: Securitatea aeroportului
programme.desc: Agenţii de securitate ai aeroportului columbian El Dorado se confruntă cu situaţii riscante: de la trafic de droguri la furt de identitate.

programme.title: Securitatea aeroportului
programme.desc: Agenţii de securitate ai aeroportului columbian El Dorado se confruntă cu situaţii riscante: de la trafic de droguri la furt de identitate.

programme.title: Insula fără legi
programme.desc: Pe o insulă îndepărtată din sud-estul Alaskăi, un mic grup de oameni fabuloşi se străduie să supravieţuiască din roadele pământului şi ale mării.

programme.title: Insula fără legi
programme.desc: Pe o insulă îndepărtată din sud-estul Alaskăi, un mic grup de oameni fabuloşi se străduie să supravieţuiască din roadele pământului şi ale mării.

programme.title: Supraviețuire în Northwoods
programme.desc: În vastele sălbăticii ale Yukonului, Margot caută locul perfect pentru a-și construi noua cabană din Northwoods. Matty descoperă că gospodăria lui din Newfoundland nu este atât de pregătită pentru iarna care se apropie cu repeziciune. Billy recurge la câteva tehnici vechi de școală pentru a face unele îmbunătățiri, iar Emile și Gilbert fac primul pas pentru a construi casa de vis a familiei.

programme.title: Dezastre în aer

programme.title: Inginerie de excepție
programme.desc: Mai înalte, mai lungi, mai puternice. Constructorii de macarale se întrec în atingerea de superlative. Knaack Krane Hamburg este una dintre marile companii de macarale capabile să creeze acești transformatori din viața reală.

programme.desc: Arheologii descifrează misterele celui mai celebru faraon al Egiptului, Tutankhamon, în urma descoperirii unor comori prețioase în mormântul acestuia.
